title: Before Bronze
tagline: A documentary series in eight episodes

speakers.label: Research
speakers.role: States what named researchers argue, in their own terms, on every side of a question.

speakers.label: From the sources
speakers.role: Reads historical texts: Thomsen, Lubbock, explorers, excavation diaries.

audition.text: In 1836 a Copenhagen museum keeper sorted the past into stone, bronze and iron. The name stuck, though stone is simply what survives.
